findings.title: AGENTS.md still states that the first launch in a new worktree builds its images, whereas sidecar images are now shared
findings.body: AGENTS.md:309: AGENTS.md still states that the first launch in a new worktree builds its images, whereas sidecar images are now shared per service and Dockerfile version across all worktrees and projects on the host. — evidence: AGENTS.md:309-310 says 'The first launch in a new worktree builds its images (LAUNCH_IMAGE_BUILDING; then /mcp reconnect all).' Commit 02658fcbe changed docker_runtime.compose_image_name (src/dopemux/mcp/docker_runtime.py:487-516) to tag dopemux-<service>:<12-hex-sha256> per service and Dockerfile content, and updated docs/02-how-to/mcp-setup-other-repos.md:122-128 and .claude/claude.md:270-273 accordingly, leaving AGENTS.md:309 with the pre-I4 wording.

remaining_risks: AGENTS.md:309 contains stale wording implying image builds happen per new worktree rather than once per service/Dockerfile version on the host (Finding F1, low).

In stdio_proxy.py:316-329, an initial connect failure consumes the 60-second reconnect window budget via the immediate startup retry, so if the backend subsequently restarts within 60 seconds of that retry, the proxy will exit 1 and require '/mcp reconnect' rather than auto-healing a second time inside the same 60-second window.
